meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 它会先在临时工作区复现 bug,做出最小的正确修复,并附上修复前/后的日志与补丁。LazyCodex 自身的缺陷会提成带补丁的 issue,只有上游 Codex CLI 的缺陷才从 fork 提 PR。
howto.when: 当你说要修 bug、提交 bug fix、为某个 bug 开 PR,或要调试 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发;它会先对比两个仓库来判断该提 issue 还是 PR。

say.text: 帮我修一下 LazyCodex 的这个 bug,把复现步骤也记下来
say.note: 会复现、修复并生成验证日志和补丁

say.text: 这个 bug 在上游 Codex CLI 也能复现,给我开个 PR
say.note: 会从你的 fork 向 openai/codex 提 PR

say.text: 把这次的修复做成 issue 提到 code-yeongyu/lazycodex
say.note: 会内嵌 diff 补丁并附上验证日志

howto.what_en: It reproduces the bug, makes the smallest correct fix in a temp workspace, and attaches before/after logs and a patch. LazyCodex defects become a verified-fix issue; only upstream Codex CLI defects become a fork PR.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect; it compares both repos to decide between an issue and a PR.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug for me and record the reproduction steps
say_en.note: Reproduces, fixes, and produces verification logs plus a patch

say_en.text: This bug also reproduces on upstream Codex CLI, open a PR
say_en.note: Opens a PR from your fork to openai/codex

say_en.text: File this fix as an issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex
say_en.note: Embeds the diff patch and verification logs
